$description.$value: Interaction modifier ratios — the amount by which a resting colour is shifted to express a state. Two operations, kept apart because their magnitudes are not comparable: alpha lays a translucent veil over an unknown surface, mix blends a known solid base into a new opaque colour. Direction is not carried here: it is chosen by the ink the component mixes or overlays with, ob.s.color.static.black to darken or ob.s.color.static.white to lighten. Use: inside a component's modify configuration. Avoid: as a freely pickable opacity in the semantic layer.
Ratios for a translucent overlay on a surface the component does not own. Monotone: subtle < medium < strong.
Ratio for blending a known solid base with an ink. The result is opaque. Not on the alpha ladder: a mix ratio and an alpha ratio of the same number produce different amounts of change.
